title: Not Comfortable Under the Feet
text:
Not Comfortable Under the Feet. I am generally a fan of Norwex microfiber bath products, but certainly not this bath mat. It's just not comfortable at all under my feet. Yes, the microfiber itself is soft, but the mat lacks any kind of cushion. In addition to it not having the cushion you'd expect, it feels like it has somewhat hard areas under my feet.

Also, the mat does not contain BacLock, which Norwex puts into most of its other microfiber bath products to inhibit bacterial growth.

Since I do not like how it feels while standing on it, I cannot recommend it at all.
